primary_result: All frozen train-only qualification gates passed. The complete 3,000-haze and 3,000-clear census yielded 3,000 deterministic loader-selected, decodable, dimension-aligned pairs grouped into exactly 750 canonical clear scenes, each with exactly four nested haze observations. The fixed-salt ranking assigned 600 scenes and 2,400 haze observations to training and 150 scenes and 600 haze observations to internal development, with complete role disjointness and coverage.
gate_reasons: train-only asset scope passed with official test absent and all protected permissions disabled
all 3,000 haze and clear files paired, decoded, and aligned
exactly 750 canonical clear scenes and exactly four haze observations per scene were recovered
the deterministic 600/150 scene split retained all 3,000 observations without cross-role scene leakage
competing_explanation: Decoded RGB identity validates the frozen canonical grouping and leakage-control rule but does not establish original capture provenance or the physical meaning of the numeric filename suffixes; the four clear aliases may reflect dataset packaging.
limitations: This is Haze4K train-only development-screening evidence and makes no official-test or model-performance claim.
All 3,000 haze observations remain available, but uncertainty and downstream resampling must treat 750 clear scenes, not files or variants, as independent.
The previously reproduced official ConvIR-B test metric remains baseline background only; no test outcome, model, or checkpoint was accessed.
Only aggregate counts and the assignment digest were archived; downstream routes must reproduce assignments from the frozen salt and canonical rule.
